sessions_principal_arc_check.name: sessions_principal_arc_check
sessions_principal_arc_check.value:
("sman"."sessions"."principal_type" = 'staff'    AND "sman"."sessions"."staff_id"    IS NOT NULL AND "sman"."sessions"."customer_id" IS NULL)
       OR ("sman"."sessions"."principal_type" = 'customer' AND "sman"."sessions"."customer_id" IS NOT NULL AND "sman"."sessions"."staff_id"    IS NULL)

audit_logs_actor_arc_check.name: audit_logs_actor_arc_check
audit_logs_actor_arc_check.value:
("sman"."audit_logs"."actor_type" = 'staff'    AND "sman"."audit_logs"."actor_staff_id"    IS NOT NULL AND "sman"."audit_logs"."actor_customer_id" IS NULL)
       OR ("sman"."audit_logs"."actor_type" = 'customer' AND "sman"."audit_logs"."actor_customer_id" IS NOT NULL AND "sman"."audit_logs"."actor_staff_id"    IS NULL)
       OR ("sman"."audit_logs"."actor_type" = 'system'   AND "sman"."audit_logs"."actor_staff_id"    IS NULL     AND "sman"."audit_logs"."actor_customer_id" IS NULL)
